ios.desc:
Play the music you own, including FLAC, MP3, and ALAC, completely offline and with no subscription. MiniMoon is free to try, with a one-time purchase to unlock everything.

Enjoy your collection without distractions:
• Clean, modern interface designed entirely around listening.
• Album-first browsing that encourages deeper, long-form listening.
• Discover, an album-by-album feed for finding what to play next.
• Works offline with your local library, no internet required.
• Fast, always-available search across your entire collection.

Powerful tools for serious library listeners:
• Smart collections that fill themselves from your rules, plus traditional playlists.
• Favorites keeps albums in your current rotation within easy reach.
• Graphic equalizer that is powerful and easy to use, with ReplayGain support.
• Synced lyrics from LRC files, or downloaded once and saved next to your music.
• Sleep timer.
• Play through AirPlay speakers.
• Edit tags across multiple file formats.
• Add or replace cover art.
• Scrobble what you play to Last.fm.
• Use Play Random Album to rediscover hidden gems.
• Sync your library over Wi-Fi from a MiniMoon sync server, with transfers that resume if interrupted.

Format support:
• MP3, M4A (AAC and ALAC), FLAC, OPUS, WAV, and AIFF.
• Surround playback for 5.1 and 7.1 files, or mixed down cleanly to stereo.
• Imports M3U playlists.
